command: docker run --rm --network aios_aios-net --user 65534:65534 aios-aios:executor-proof python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/test_executor_integration.py

checks.restart: docker compose restart executor; docker compose up -d --wait executor

proofs.name: Isolated Workspace and Executor (current-tip live proof)
proofs.command: tests/test_executor_integration.py before and after docker compose executor restart
proofs.evidence: Current-tip control-plane proof image ran all 4 integration checks successfully before restart and again after restart. The real Docker-backed executor proved uid=65534, network=blocked, outside=blocked, bounded output truncation, trace propagation, timeout refusal, and missing-service refusal. Both runs exited 0; executor health was healthy after each startup. The Docker socket was available only to the private executor container; the control-plane proof container had no socket mount.
